summary: Ashok Kumar Chatterjee (1925–2021) worked in philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He earned his BA, MA, and PhD at Banaras Hindu University, studying under T. R. V. Murti, and held professorships at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University and BHU.

Ashok Kumar Malhotra (born 1940) is a scholar in philosophy and Indology who studied at the East-West Center from circa 1964 to 1969. He founded the Yoga and Meditation Society for the Scientific Study of Spirituality.

Ashok Ramchandra Kelkar (1929–2014) was a linguist and Indologist who studied at Savitribai Phule Pune University and Cornell University. He held posts at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University, Savitribai Phule Pune University, and Deccan College.

Ashoka Welitota works in Buddhist studies. He served as a Senior Lecturer Gr. II at the University of Kelaniya in 2016 and is attested as a Senior Lecturer at the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies in 2026.

Ashutosh Mishra studied at the Central University of Gujarat, earning a Master of Library & Information Science in 2022. He worked at the Institute of Rural Management Anand, Bennett University, and Parul University.

Ashutosh Mukherjee (1864–1924) studied at Presidency University and the University of Calcutta. He served at the Calcutta High Court, was Tagore Professor of Law at the University of Calcutta, and served as President of The Asiatic Society.

Ashutosh Pareek completed a PhD at Jagadguru Ramanandacharya Rajasthan Sanskrit University in 2012. An Indologist, he became a professor at Samrat Prithviraj Chauhan Government College in 2008 and has served as visiting faculty at Hindu University of America.

Asim Kumar Chatterjee (born 1940) is an Indology and history scholar who earned his PhD at the University of Calcutta in 1967 under D. Mukherjee. He served as a lecturer at Jangipur College and a Senior Research Fellow at Calcutta.

Asko Parpola (born 1941) is a scholar of Indology and linguistics. He completed his PhD at the University of Helsinki under Pentti Aalto, and later served as a professor at the University of Helsinki from circa 1982 to 2020.
Assa Doron is a scholar of Indology who completed a PhD at La Trobe University between 2000 and 2005. In 2007, Doron was appointed Professor at the Australian National University.

Astley John Hilary Goodwin (1900–1959) worked in history and archaeology. He studied at St. John's College, Selwyn College, and SOAS University of London, and took up a post at the University of Cape Town in 1923.

Astrid Zotter is an Indology and religious studies scholar who completed a PhD at the University of Leipzig. She has held posts at the Heidelberg Academy of Sciences and Humanities and Heidelberg University.
Athanaric Huard is an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Georges-Jean Pinault. Huard is attested as an Assistent at the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities in 2026.
Athanasius Pryor Treweek (1911–1995) was an Indology and linguistics scholar. He studied at the University of Sydney from circa 1928 to 1934 and became Professor of Greek there in 1938.

Atsuhiko Yoshida (born 1934), a religious studies and history scholar, studied at the University of Tokyo, EPHE, and under Georges Dumézil. He held research posts at CNRS and professorships at Seikei University and Gakushuin University.
Atsuki Nakagami is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. Nakagami served as a visiting researcher at the University of Hamburg and is affiliated with the Nakamura Hajime Eastern Institute.
Atsushi Ibuki (born 1959) is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Waseda University from circa 1978 to 1988. Ibuki became a professor at Toyo University circa 2004.

Atsushi Kanazawa (born 1951) works in Indology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy. After studying at the University of Tokyo, Kanazawa taught at the Meteorological College before taking up a post at Komazawa University in 1993.

Atsushi Kiyozawa (born 1951) is a scholar in Indology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy who completed doctoral coursework at the University of Delhi. He was attested as a lecturer at Kindai University in 1989.

Atsushi Uno (born 1922) studied Indology and philosophy at Kyoto University and Banaras Hindu University, completing his doctorate under T. R. V. Murti. He held posts at Shuchiin, Kyoto, Tokai, Hiroshima, and Kindai universities.
